A '''husk''' in [[Matcha Flavoured]] is a slow, heavily armored undead "tank". While [[Zombie|zombies]] are fast and fragile, husks on Normal and Hard have up to 20 hearts, strong armor, near-total knockback resistance and very heavy hits. They spawn in every Overworld biome, not just deserts, and the resource pack makes them white to set them apart from zombies.

== Spawning ==
Husks are added to every Overworld biome that spawns monsters, with weight 75 in groups of 1–2. In deserts this replaces the vanilla weight of 80 in groups of 4.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/worldgen/biome/plains.json}}</ref> Like other undead, they can spawn on the open surface until the [[Ender Dragon]] is killed; see [[Spawning]] and [[Surface]].

Husk jockeys are removed: a husk that spawns riding a camel husk is replaced by a husk on foot, and the camel husk is left alone.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/spawn_mechanic/remove_camel_husk_jockey.mcfunction}}</ref> Husks also come from spawners in [[Abbey|abbeys]]; those husks drop nothing.

== Drops ==
{{Data/Loot/minecraft/entities/husk}}
All drops require a player kill, and husks from the pack's spawners drop nothing.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/entities/husk.json}}</ref> Compared to vanilla, husks drop {{ItemLink|Sturdy Leather}} (1–2) instead of rotten flesh, and have a 10 in 16 chance of rolling {{ItemLink|Raw Estus}} (0–1) instead of the rare iron, carrot and potato drops.

== Behavior ==
On Normal and Hard, a husk moves slowly but steadily: it has full movement efficiency on land and in water, so slowing blocks such as soul sand and moving through water hold it back far less than other mobs, and it steps up full blocks without jumping. Its high knockback resistance means shields and knockback weapons barely push it back, and its follow range lets it track players from much further away than vanilla mobs.<ref name="n">{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/spawn_mechanic/normal_modifications/modify_husk.mcfunction}}</ref><ref name="h">{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/spawn_mechanic/hard_modifications/modify_husk.mcfunction}}</ref>

Husks are undead and are affected by [[warding]].

== Trivia ==
* The 1.10 release notes describe the design: "Zombies will try to distract you with smaller, quicker blows while the husk advances, and once he gets to you, its all over."<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.10|quote=Zombies will try to distract you with smaller, quicker blows while the husk advances, and once he gets to you, its all over.}}</ref>
* The 1.12 notes add: "Husk does not have increased attack range to vanilla, im not sure why people thought they did".
* The 1.12.2 notes recommend Easy or Normal to players who don't enjoy "getting one-tapped by husks".
